initiatives.name: Oklahomans for Equality (OKEQ)
initiatives.description: A statewide organization seeking equal rights for 2SLGBTQIA+ individuals and families through intersectional advocacy, education, and mutual aid programs. They operate the Dennis R. Neill Equality Center in Tulsa, providing health services, counseling, community spaces, and direct support while building networks of care and solidarity across Oklahoma.

initiatives.name: Trans Advocacy Oklahoma
initiatives.description: Grassroots group for trans, Two-Spirit, intersex and gender-diverse Oklahomans. It holds rallies and social events and gives direct aid through its partner, the Gender Umbrella Assistance Collective.

initiatives.name: Freedom Oklahoma
initiatives.description: Oklahoma City-based statewide group that advocates for 2SLGBTQ+ Oklahomans through education, HIV decriminalization work, youth programs, community organizing and resource referrals.

initiatives.name: Diversity Center of Oklahoma
initiatives.description: An LGBTQ+ and gender-diverse community center in Oklahoma City that offers behavioral health counseling and community resources, working out of the Expressions Community Center on NW 39th St.

initiatives.name: The Beacon Project
initiatives.description: A Norman nonprofit, formerly Pantry Partners, that gives high school teens facing hunger or homelessness free food, hygiene items, school supplies and tutoring.

initiatives.name: OKHRA
initiatives.description: Oklahoma Harm Reduction Alliance, a grassroots harm reduction organization providing low barrier access to life saving supplies for people who use drugs (PWUD) in Oklahoma.
